notes.subject: ponagalo
notes.rationale: מראת — ponagalo (seo a se bonago); e ka ba seipone ka mo go tlwaelegileng, fela mo ke ponagalo

notes.subject: Yaakobo, Yaakobo
notes.rationale: Go bušwa ga leina gabedi — go bitswa ga motho ka tlwaelo ya Seheberu ge Elohim a mmitsa; phetolelo e boloka go bušwa gabedi

notes.subject: הנני
notes.rationale: Mo go tlwaelegilego 'Ke fano'; mo go hlapolela go itsephagantšha: Bonake, ke fano

notes.subject: to Yaakobo
notes.rationale: Elohim o bitsa Yaakobo ka leina la gagwe ka go kgetha

translation: Gomme Elohim a bolela le Yisraele ka ponagalo ya bošego, a re: Yaakobo, Yaakobo. Gomme a re: Bonake, ke fano.
